signals.title: AUD/CHF — G10 Bilateral Theme + Carry
signals.text: AUD/CHF trades at 0.5807, holding above its SMA20 at 0.5780 while testing the 0.5820 resistance zone. The G10 scorecard shows a 1.195% weekly spread between AUD (1W avg +0.487%, 4 pairs) and CHF (1W avg -0.708%, 6 pairs), crossing the critical 1.20% theme threshold. A massive +460bp nominal policy rate advantage (RBA 4.60% vs SNB 0.00%) strongly favors AUD carry, further backed by a positive real rate differential. Australian Q3 CPI data at 00:30 UTC serves as the immediate catalyst to validate the hawkish RBA bias ahead of the Nov 3 meeting. Trade bias: Long AUD/CHF, strong carry differential and G10 scorecard leadership favor upside expansion. Catalyst: Australia Q3 CPI release at 00:30 UTC (forecast 1.1% q/q). Risk: A downside CPI surprise cools RBA hike expectations and triggers a fast carry unwind toward 0.5750.

supports: price moved 1.7 ATR with it over five sessions

signals.title: USD/JPY — Carry Premium + Options SKEW
signals.text: USD/JPY trades at 157.49, holding below its SMA20/50 cluster at 157.87/157.55 in a confirmed short-term downtrend structure. OIS carry at +267bp (SOFR 3.90% vs TONA 1.23%) and a 275bp policy rate gap (Fed 4.00% vs BoJ 1.25%) maintain structural support for the dollar leg. However, Saxo 25d Risk Reversals print an extreme -2.15 put skew, revealing intense institutional hedging demand for JPY downside protection despite COT Leveraged Funds running net short -25,598 contracts. VIX at 18.4 (normal volatility) keeps carry dominant, but options market positioning points to rising anxiety ahead of the Oct 28 Fed and Oct 30 BoJ decisions. Trade bias: Neutral/Range USD/JPY, strong carry support offset by aggressive institutional downside options hedging. Catalyst: BoJ Trimmed Mean CPI release at 05:00 UTC followed by the Oct 28 Fed decision. Risk: A hawkish BoJ surprise combined with a breach of 156.80 confirms a broader unwind toward 155.00.

signals.title: NZD/USD — COT vs OIS Divergence + RBNZ
signals.text: NZD/USD trades at 0.5683, holding above its SMA20 at 0.5637 while testing short-term resistance near 0.5700. RBNZ holds at 2.75%. RBNZ at 2.75% (hiking bias) contrasts with market expectations, creating an asymmetric short-squeeze setup if the central bank delivers a hawkish hike. Additionally, NZD ESI sits at -16.0 (strong negative bias), showing economic data misses have fed spec shorts into a potential policy trap. Trade bias: Long NZD/USD, asymmetric short-squeeze setup against crowded spec positioning ahead of RBNZ. Catalyst: RBNZ Interest Rate Decision and Rate Statement on Oct 28 at 01:00 UTC. Risk: RBNZ holds rates at 2.75% and adopts a dovish tone, validating spec shorts and driving price below 0.5637.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Options Skew + Vol Premium
signals.text: EUR/USD trades at 1.1178, remaining below its SMA20/50/200 cluster (1.1238/1.1440/1.1577) in a established downtrend. Saxo 1M ATM Implied Volatility prints 6.5% against 30-day Realized Volatility of 4.2%, generating a +2.4% Vol Risk Premium that signals elevated demand for options protection over realized spot movement. COT Leveraged Funds maintain an extreme net short of -94,138 contracts (pctl 2, z -1.72), reflecting heavy institutional positioning for lower spot prices. The SOFR-€STR OIS spread at +146bp (+135bp nominal CB rate differential) continues to anchor carry in favor of USD. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD, downside trend structure aligned with extreme COT positioning and carry advantage. Catalyst: ECB President Lagarde speech on Oct 28 at 17:00 UTC and ECB Policy Decision on Oct 29. Risk: A hawkish ECB shift triggers short covering above the 1.1238 SMA20 resistance level.
